method.scope: Majority adjudication of three independent gold label sets. No relabelling from scratch, no Skill execution, no scoring, no question-design access.
method.scalars: route, responsibility, tone, and overall are decided by plurality of the three labelers; overall is then checked against the fixed Red > Gray > Yellow > Green derivation.
method.required_lists: A concept enters required_question_concepts or required_revision_concepts when at least two of three labelers required it.
method.allowed_lists: Allowed lists are the union of the three labelers allowed lists plus the adjudicated required concepts, minus concepts incompatible with the adjudicated rating. The only exclusions applied were rewrite-implying revision concepts on the three Green/Green turns V334-014-T1, V334-015-T1 and V334-016-T1, because a Green/Green review owes no rewrite.
method.critical_invariants: A token is carried when at least two of three labelers listed it.
method.uncertainty: gold_uncertain is used only where no two labelers agree or where the v3.3 rules do not support the majority label. A decided label is preferred whenever two labelers agree and the v3.3 rules support it.
v3_3_rules_applied: Established omission of a token a named execution step depends on is Red, not Gray (V334-004 through V334-008).

An occluded token in Data B forces Intake with null ratings; an occluded Data A or background token with an identifiable sendable draft stays Normal mode with the affected dimension Gray and a question (V334-009).
preserve-intended-recipient never appears in required_revision_concepts; it appears only in allowed lists.
Green/Green turns carry required_revision_concepts ["no-revision"] and no rewrite.
